figurative_meaning_en: pulling each other's hair (indicating a petty or intense quarrel)
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই বোন চুলোচুলি করে উঠল যখন খেলনা নিয়ে ঝগড়া হলো।
পাড়ায় চুলোচুলি শুরু হয়েছে ছোটখাটো বিষয় নিয়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: The two sisters started a hair-pulling fight when they quarreled over the toy.
A petty squabble in the neighborhood has turned into a hair-pulling brawl.
note: This idiom often evokes imagery of physical scuffles, commonly associated with sibling or neighborly rivalries in Bengali culture.
